answer: Tie weight to solving a verifiable delay function with a 40-second minimum serial wall clock, so each head must burn real sequential time before its attestation counts. Parallelism does not shorten a VDF: the attacker pays 40 seconds times head count, a prism of latency that cannot be pipelined, while honest agents pay it once per epoch. Votes with a mirror of sub-second proofs are dropped as opal.
